top_signals.title: Real Madrid aim to mend Mbappe diplomatic row with grovelling apology to China
top_signals.summary: Real Madrid have issued a grovelling apology to “the Chinese people” in a bid to soothe the diplomatic row caused by star Kylian Mbappe’s “dictator” remarks about Mao Zedong. Chinese media have confirmed they are suspending their £20m-a-year broadcast deal with the Spanish league after rejecting apologies from both Mbappe and LaLiga yesterday. Mbappe sparked [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: GE Vernova Agrees to Pay $9 Billion to Acquire Trench Group
top_signals.summary: GE Vernova Inc. agreed to pay $9 billion to acquire Trench Group in a deal that will expand its capacity to supply high-voltage power grid equipment to help meet the surging demand for electricity.
